overloadMerges.note: one and many are both filled in by the command (out), not in parameters.

params.name: one
params.description: True if a previous SET AUTOMATIC RELATIONS call made all manual many-to-one relations automatic for the current process; False otherwise

params.name: many
params.description: True if a previous SET AUTOMATIC RELATIONS call made all manual one-to-many relations automatic for the current process; False otherwise

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Reports, via one and many, whether SET AUTOMATIC RELATIONS has switched all manual many-to-one and one-to-many relations to automatic for the current process.
